description: Customisable settings for the booking-panel app

name.description: Application name sent with PlaceOS API requests. Falls back to `short_name`.

short_name.description: Prefix for console log messages. Also used as the API application name when `name` is not set.

logo_light.description: Logo displayed on the event panel when the light theme is active. Either an image URL string or an object with a `src` image URL.

logo_dark.description: Logo displayed on the event panel when the dark theme is active. Either an image URL string or an object with a `src` image URL.

prevent_space_init.description: Whether to prevent the spaces service from loading the full list of bookable spaces on startup

allow_dark_mode.description: Whether the user is allowed to switch the app between light and dark themes. When disabled the app is locked to the light theme.

text_color.description: CSS colour for text on the event panel view. Defaults to `#FFFFFF`.

background_color.description: CSS colour for the background of the event panel view. Defaults to `#483285`.

background_image.description: URL of the background image to render on the event panel view

refresh_when_websocket_unstable.description: Whether to reload the page when the websocket connection to the PlaceOS backend is repeatedly dropping

user_as_default_host.description: Whether the signed-in user's email should be used as the host for `book_now` bookings when no host is set

features.description: List of opt-in panel features. All features are off by default.

night_start.description: Local time in `HH:mm` format when the `night_mode` feature starts to dim the panel. Defaults to `19:00`.

night_end.description: Local time in `HH:mm` format when the `night_mode` feature stops dimming the panel. Defaults to `07:00`.

enabled.description: Whether to show the global chat widget. Off when not set.

environment_bar.description: CSS colour for thin identifier bars at the top and bottom of the app. Leave unset to hide the bars.

presence_release_after.description: Minutes after the start of a pending booking with no presence detected before the `presence_release` feature releases it. Defaults to `5`.

banner.description: Message banner shown at the top of the app. The user can close it.

id.description: Unique ID for the banner. A closed banner stays hidden until the ID changes.

type.description: Colour style for the banner. Defaults to `info`.

content.description: Message text to show in the banner
